title: Seller needs to rewrite the discription ... wouldn't deter but help buyers.
text: Seller needs to rewrite the discription ... wouldn't deter but help buyers.. I believe the description was poorly written and the photos made it difficult to verify what is actually being sent to the purchaser.  Although not horribly disappointed with my purchase this is what I did and my description of the product.  There is a total of 30 items in each package: 15 silver swirls with 15 double tiered white flakes at end of each individual swirl (i.e., a larger, 5-inch flake and a smaller flake, 3-inch flake which is attached to larger one) ... the next are 15 white swirls with 15 silver flakes. all large snowflakes pattern/design are same and the smaller ones are different than the large flakes, but are comparable design. The products are made from a adequate light weight plastic-y material/paper. The total length is approximately 22-inches (give or take).  There is a transparent string with a small hoop to allow a hook to be attached to hang each 'mobile'.  I ordered two packages and am planning on switching t o silver swirls with silver flakes and white swirls with white flakes.
